answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn or vote, and slash that stake when peer panels prove duplicate identities share one controller. Honest agents bridge between groups and wander freely, collecting rewards like nectar, while a Sybil farmer must lock separate capital for every fake identity. Splitting into a thousand sockpuppets therefore costs a thousand stakes, and detection burns them all, making the attack pricier than its payout.
